title: EndFrame

subscription.description: A subscription's id, chosen by the environment and carried by every subscription message.

reason.description: Why a subscription ended: the client unsubscribed; it fell too far behind (resubscribe from its cursor); its client session was revoked; the connection closed; or what it follows was deleted (a session's subscription, after delivering session.deleted).

description: From the environment: the subscription is over, and why.
